_about: The camera on the heroine (D83, 20.11.2026). zoom: how much closer than one room pixel per screen pixel (3 = she is about 280 px tall on a 1080 screen, a quarter of it; Boris 20.11: at 2 she still looked like a bug). lead_px: how far ahead of her the camera looks in the direction she faces, in room pixels; lead_speed: how fast that look turns when she turns (per second). follow_speed: how fast the camera catches up with her. overview_start_seconds: the whole room is shown this long at the start of a level (any move key ends it sooner). overview_blend_seconds: how long the camera takes between the overview and the close view. The overview is the whole room fitted into the screen; hold the 'overview' key (Tab) to see it. feet_screen_y: where her feet stand on the screen in the close view, from the top (0.5 the middle, 1 the bottom; Д5.1, Boris 20.11: not half a screen of floor); the camera still keeps to the room.
